info.name: Bulldogs Exchange API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Bulldogs Exchange REST API (NU campus marketplace).

1. Import this collection and `Bulldogs_Exchange_Local.postman_environment.json`.
2. Select the **Bulldogs Exchange - Local** environment.
3. Start the server (`npm start` in panahon-server) and run the seed once (`npm run seed`).
4. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner. Folders run in order and pass ids/tokens along through environment variables.

Swagger UI: http://localhost:5000/api-docs

exec: // Runs after every request in the collection

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Checks the API is up and logs in the seeded Admin and Customer accounts. **Run this folder first**: it stores `adminToken` and `customerToken` in the environment for every other request.

exec: pm.test("Message is: Invalid email or password.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid email or password."));
pm.test("Message is: Authentication required. Please log in.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Authentication required. Please log in."));
pm.test("Message is: Invalid session token. Please log in again.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid session token. Please log in again."));

item.name: Users
item.description: Account lifecycle: REGISTER and LOGIN a brand-new user, then profile, password and admin management. The new user is deleted at the end so the folder can be re-run.

exec: // Unique email per run so repeated runs never hit 409
pm.test("Message is: Account created successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Account created successfully."));
pm.test("Message is: An account with this email already exists.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("An account with this email already exists."));
pm.test("Message is: Invalid email or password.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Invalid email or password."));
pm.test("Message is: Profile retrieved successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Profile retrieved successfully."));
pm.test("Message is: Profile updated successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Profile updated successfully."));
pm.test("data.name is 'Postman Tester Updated'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.name).to.eql("Postman Tester Updated"));
pm.test("Message is: Password changed successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Password changed successfully."));
pm.test("Message is: Your current password is incorrect.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Your current password is incorrect."));
pm.test("data is an array and count matches", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an("array"); if ("count" in b) pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(b.data.length); });
pm.test("Every result is a Customer", () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.role).to.eql("Customer")));
pm.test("Message is: Access denied. This action requires the Admin role.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Access denied. This action requires the Admin role."));
pm.test("Message is: User retrieved successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("User retrieved successfully."));
pm.test("data.name is 'Postman Tester Updated'", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.name).to.eql("Postman Tester Updated"));
pm.test("Message is: Account deactivated successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Account deactivated successfully."));

pm.test("Message is: This account has been deactivated. Please contact an administrator.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("This account has been deactivated. Please contact an administrator."));
pm.test("Message is: User deleted successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("User deleted successfully."));
pm.test("Message is: User not found.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("User not found."));

item.name: Products
item.description: Catalog CRUD plus the Cloudinary image upload. Creates a helper category and a test product that the Reviews, Carts and Orders folders reuse; the **Cleanup** folder deletes them.

exec: pm.test("data is an array and count matches", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an("array"); if ("count" in b) pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(b.data.length); });

pm.test("Pagination fields present", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); ["total", "totalPages", "currentPage"].forEach(k => pm.expect(b).to.have.property(k)); pm.expect(b.currentPage).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("Sorted by price, high to low", () => { const p = pm.response.json().data.map(x => x.price); pm.expect(p).to.eql([...p].sort((a, b) => b - a)); });
pm.test("Message is: Product created successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Product created successfully."));

item.description: Checkout and the order lifecycle. Stock is checked before and after to prove that placing an order reserves it and cancelling restores it.

exec: pm.test("Message is: Your cart is empty. Add a product before checking out.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Your cart is empty. Add a product before checking out."));
pm.test("Message is: Order placed successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Order placed successfully."));
pm.test("data is an array and count matches", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an("array"); if ("count" in b) pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(b.data.length); });
pm.test("Message is: Order retrieved successfully.", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Order retrieved successfully."));
pm.test("data is an array and count matches", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.data).to.be.an("array"); if ("count" in b) pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(b.data.length); });
pm.test("Message is: Order marked as \"Confirmed\".", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Order marked as \"Confirmed\"."));
